Ananya Gupta  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-54-890-1234 | ananya.gupta@email.com  

Professional Summary  
Senior Product Manager with 8 years of experience driving enterprise software solutions across 3+ continents. Specialized in analytics-driven product strategy, with a focus on user-centric design and cross-functional collaboration. Proven ability to translate complex business needs into scalable product roadmaps, achieving 25%+ user retention growth in key initiatives. MBA from INSEAD, with a track record of mentoring product teams and influencing technical architecture decisions.  

Professional Experience  
**Senior Product Manager** | StrataCorp (2020–present)  
Led the development of enterprise SaaS platforms for 500+ clients, prioritizing features based on SQL analytics of user behavior data. Spearheaded A/B testing frameworks that reduced onboarding friction by 18%, while leveraging Tableau to create interactive dashboards for stakeholder reporting. Owned the roadmap for a $12M product line, resulting in 30% YoY revenue growth. Collaborated with engineering and UX teams to refine user journey maps, improving conversion rates by 12% in 6 months.  

**Product Manager** | Verve Systems (2016–2018)  
Designed and launched a cloud-based analytics tool for 200+ enterprise clients, integrating Power BI for real-time data visualization. Managed stakeholder expectations across 5 departments, aligning product goals with business KPIs. Introduced a structured process for analytics-driven decisions, which reduced feature development cycle times by 20%.  

**Product Analyst** | NexaTech Solutions (2014–2016)  
Analyzed user engagement metrics using SQL to identify pain points in B2B SaaS tools. Developed data visualization reports that informed 4 key product updates, contributing to a 15% increase in client retention. Collaborated with stakeholders to map user journeys, resulting in a 10% improvement in customer satisfaction scores.

- **Data Visualization**: Created 8+ visual reports that clarified complex datasets for non-technical audiences.  
- **Stakeholder Management**: Coordinated 20+ cross-departmental initiatives, maintaining alignment on 5+ product launches.  
- **User Journey Mapping**: Redesigned onboarding flows for 3 products, improving first-time user success rates by 22%.  
- **A/B Testing**: Implemented frameworks for 10+ experiments, contributing to 25% uplift in key metrics.
